title: Student V0.1 G3 — Wave 2 review and Fan-in B input freeze
purpose: Perform the independent G3 review required by the Student V0.1 program, close JOB06's deferred semantic-review gate, challenge exact Wave 2 output compatibility, and freeze a non-repairing JOB08 Fan-in B input manifest.
invariants: G3 is a review gate, not an integration or repair job.
G3 starts from the repaired-product evidence head and does not cherry-pick or merge JOB05, JOB06 or JOB07 outputs.
The independent JOB06 semantic-review phase must be completed before reading JOB06 author-side audit, provenance, quality-report or qualification conclusions.
Semantic review may receive only exact source bytes, learner brief, candidate, factory context and public reviewer/factory authorities.
authorScratchpadSeen and authorActiveContextReused must both remain false; otherwise semantic review HOLDs.
The semantic review must bind exactly to the frozen four-hash Factory target.
A semantic HOLD or deterministic Factory HOLD blocks G3; G3 does not repair JOB06.
After semantic review is durably frozen, G3 may inspect all accepted Wave 2 evidence and perform read-only temporary cross-output compatibility probes.
JOB06 showcase content remains byte-identical; no G3 mutation of the kit is allowed.
JOB07 R2 packaging code may be materialized read-only into a temporary workspace for compatibility proof but is not committed on the G3 branch.
JOB05 R1 QA implementation may be inspected as evidence but is not consumed or mutated by G3.
Any sibling workflow changes are classified as integrator-owned overlap; G3 must not merge or resolve them.
G3 PASS freezes exact Fan-in B inputs and a path-level integration policy; it does not create or execute JOB08.
No main merge, release promotion or real-student execution is authorized.
requiredEvidence: Fresh HCP binding and exact live PR states for #411, #413, #408 and #418.
Exact SHA and ancestry verification for all four accepted inputs.
Independent JOB06 semantic review over exact source/brief/candidate/context with all six required dimensions.
Independent recalculation of every scored JOB06 activity answer/correct mapping used in the showcase.
Source-fidelity evidence with exact source IDs/locators for required semantic dimensions.
Semantic review JSON validates under learnit.atlas.semantic_review.v1 and binds exact contextDigest, kitSha256, sourceSetDigest and briefSha256.
Deterministic factory_gate.py gate executed against the exact JOB06 candidate, brief, source and G3 semantic review; raw JSON result stored durably.
JOB06 canonical V4 validation and pedagogical quality rerun against exact candidate materialized from JOB06 RESULT_SHA.
Read-only compatibility proof that exact JOB06 candidate imports/starts/completes on repaired product bdb66bffefd6738e3cb4004d304159e9d3d048ce.
Read-only compatibility proof that exact JOB07 R2 generic builder can package the exact JOB06 candidate without modifying either and that extracted package app/kit hashes bind correctly.

At least one real packaged-browser smoke using exact JOB06 showcase on repaired app; desktop and mobile start/interaction/resume/completion are preferred and required unless an earlier causal incompatibility stops G3.
Exact JOB05 R1, JOB06 and JOB07 R2 changed-path audits and evidence/result separation verification.
Cross-output overlap matrix identifying candidate payload, evidence-only paths and integrator-owned central-file overlaps.
Fan-in B input manifest naming exact source SHAs and exact payload paths to import, plus central files that JOB08 must recompose instead of blindly cherry-pick.
Explicit JOB08 integration order and stop conditions with no silent repair.
Repository governance PASS on G3 review branch.
Final exact scope audit proving only ATLAS-WP-041 allowed paths changed.
adversarialTests: Reading AUTHOR_AUDIT.md, PEDAGOGICAL_QUALITY_REPORT.json, PROVENANCE_MAP.json, SOURCE_BASIS.md or JOB06 qualification conclusions before freezing semantic review invalidates reviewer independence and must HOLD G3.
Using JOB06's author-side provenance map as semantic source evidence is forbidden during independent review; evidence must be derived directly from the exact source.
A structurally valid kit with a wrong or ambiguous answer must HOLD semantic review.
Factory PASS may not be inferred from semantic PASS; factory_gate.py must execute on exact bytes.
JOB06 PASS may not be inferred from its previous qualification because semantic review was explicitly pending.
JOB05 R1 and JOB07 R2 workflow changes must not be silently merged together at G3.
Temporary cross-output compatibility material must not be committed to the G3 branch.
A package smoke using the generated R2 qualification kit instead of the exact JOB06 showcase does not prove Wave 2 mutual compatibility.
If exact JOB06 showcase cannot run/package against repaired product, G3 HOLDs rather than editing product/content/package code.
G3 PASS cannot authorize JOB09 or real students; only JOB08 preparation becomes eligible.
nonGoals: Repairing product, QA, showcase or packaging code.
Changing schema, authoring rules or central workflow.
rollback: Close the G3 PR and delete student-v01/g3-wave2-review. All accepted input branches and their exact result/evidence SHAs remain unchanged.
independentReview: G3 semantic review is performed in a clean reviewer phase before author-side JOB06 conclusions are read.
The semantic review is committed alone and frozen before full Wave 2 evidence is opened.
Factory gate execution, cross-output compatibility probes and path-overlap review independently challenge the accepted role outputs.
G3 performs no implementation repair; any semantic, factory, product, packaging or overlap defect returns HOLD to the owning role or Control Room.
